prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Sporefen: a luminous fungal marsh, tall toadstools and green water beneath drifting spores. A curious, buoyant melody with wooden flute and plucked strings. Acoustic strings, soft flute, gentle hand percussion, memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 1 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
